name: Feedback misclassified as Product Question
description: Model confuses feature requests or general praise/feedback with specific product inquiries due to overlapping language about features.

name: Shipping misclassified as Billing
description: Model mistakes shipping-related queries (tracking, delivery) for billing issues when text mentions payment or charges alongside shipping context.

name: Feedback misclassified as Shipping
description: Model incorrectly labels positive feedback about fast shipping or packaging as a shipping issue instead of general feedback.

name: Product Question misclassified as Technical
description: Model treats general product capability questions (device compatibility, features) as technical support issues due to mention of devices or platforms.

name: Product Question misclassified as Billing
description: Model confuses plan upgrade or feature questions with billing when text mentions plan changes or pricing.
